_comment: Bear execution playbook -- the round brief 2026-09-27 §§九-二十, codified so T-30/T-15/T-5/T-1/OPEN each have a machine-checkable script. Times are Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8).

actions: open 常规活动 -> 巨熊行动
re-read 预约自动开启 client time
on change: update event_schedule, recompute T15/T5/T1/OPEN
on page anomaly: find another direct client source; cooling-based estimation is NEVER the first source
stop all non-bear live-device capture; offline pipeline work continues
confirm: role identity, march queue (P0 may use the reserved stamina queue -- never 'keep one free' against the bear), AUTO_JOIN state, event status, device lease
all development control stops; MuMu fully handed to V2 AUTO

execution_priority.auto_join_on: observe first; JOINED -> verifier PASS directly; else LIST_DYNAMIC -> select legal row -> JOIN_RALLY
execution_priority.unknown_confirm_after_join: triggers JOIN_RALLY_CONFIRM P0 LIVE_EVENT_GAP capture-first channel
execution_priority.row_failure: FULL/TARGET_CHANGED/ROW_GONE -> reobserve -> next legal row; a stuck role waits a short window or runs non-conflicting tasks; roles stay isolated; one blocked role never freezes the system
execution_priority.row_selection: rally.select_join_candidates: target=BEAR, join_available, full!=True, same-row button, shortest timer first
execution_priority.stale_frame_guard: rally.stale_frame_reason: 3.0s validity + LIST_REFRESHED voids the reading before any click

success_contract.participation_L4: real JOIN or START of a bear rally + JOINED_STATE verifier PASS (click alone is never success)
success_contract.goal_L5: BEAR Goal predicates: participation + battle happened + reward/result state; opening the battle report is NOT required unless the Goal contract says so
success_contract.dispatch_base: DISPATCH_COMMON=L4 locked from ordinary-dispatch live proof; the event only validates BEAR_CONTEXT_DISPATCH

live_event_gaps.JOIN_RALLY_CONFIRM: P0; contract pre-agreed in pipeline_gap_queue; direct join -> NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_THIS_FLOW
live_event_gaps.RALLY_BATTLE_REPORT: P0; captured on first post-battle frame; result-read verifier; never blocks Goal L5

actions: every new page/popup/state of the day enters Gap Queue + Knowledge + UI semantics + Verifier evidence
resume normal TEMPLATE/OCR/STRUCTURE/LIST_DYNAMIC/AutoGen/AutoRepair exploration of un-covered E-class events

frozen_chains.KEEP_RESEARCH_PRODUCTIVE: L5 banked 2026-09-27; AutoRepair/real-regression fixes ONLY; no rewrites of Unicode-roman, tab or node-selection logic without new production evidence

quality_watch.fake_success_scan: SUCCESS with unchanged after-state / executed MAA with weak verifier / high-score OCR on long sentences / TEMPLATE hit with wrong page semantics -> QUALITY_GAP -> AutoRepair or verifier strengthening
quality_watch.metrics_focus_shift: from L1 count to L3/L4/L5 share; prefer L2 + frequently-triggered + no-L4 candidates promoted by natural AUTO execution
